༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sreg blugs kyi lag len bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sreg blugs kyi lag len bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsreg blugs 'bring po'i lag len ni 'di yin te/ dang por yo byad tshogs par bya ba la/ dung chos sam thod par bsangs chu ku sha dang bcas pa/ gtor ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa gnyis/ pad 'dab med pa gnyis/ bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par til nag logs su bya/ gzhan nas gro sran 'bras sogs 'bru sna tshogs bsregs pa/ dur ba/ zas mchog / ku sha /ba glang gi sha skam po la chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu bsres pas byugs pa dang*/ de bzhin du thig skud rdul tshon/ rdor dril/ ḍa ma ru/ nang mchod/ nyungs kar/ thal ba/ ba byung*/ dri bzang/ thod pa'am/ dung chos su mchod yon/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar byas/ mar khu dang*/ yam shing dang*/ dpal 'bar sogs kyang bzhag go /gnyis pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ bsangs chu la dmigs nas sum+bha brgya dang*/ mchod yon la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ brgya rtsa bzlas la bzhag /thab gang du bya ba'i sa gzhir/ gtor ma lcog zlum de bzhag la/ bsangs sbyang nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang 'dra/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin pos gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /sreg blug don du khyod kyis stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la/ zhes sogs kyis bgegs bskrad la gtor ma phyir dor/ oṃ bhuṃ khaṃ nam mkha' rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de nas sum+bha bzla bzhin du nyungs kar dang thal ba gtor ro/ /ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bsrung*/ de nas sa gzhi der thig btab la/ thab kyi dkyil 'khor legs par bris/ de yang thab sor nyi shu las mi chung ba/ mu ran kha khyer sor bzhi/ de rnams dbyibs gru gsum/

rtse mo rang la bstan pa/ dbus su pad 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar gri gug /mu ran la rdo rje dang*/ kha khyer la pad+ma 'am/ gri gug gi 'phreng ba can/ de rnams kyi gzhi kha dog dmar po yin/ stegs bu gru bzhi ser po/ zur bzhir mgo nang du bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje'o/ /thab nang du bud shing snyoms par brtsigs la me tshang bca'/ stegs bu'i phyi rol ci bde bar/ thab kyi g.yas su mchod yon dang zhabs bsil/ de'i nang du 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i chu gnyis bshams/ rang gi g.yon du snga ma'i 'phro las mthud de sreg rdzas rnams bshams/ thab kyi g.yon kyi phyogs su nyer spyod lnga dang*/ de'i nang du yang 'jig rten pa'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ rgyab kyi phyogs ci bde bar gtor ma gsum po rnams bsgrig /rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol brtsigs/ rdor dril nang mchod rnams rang gi mdun du bshams/ dgang blugs kyang mdun du bzhag go /mdun du mi bde na g.yas su 'jog cing*/ bud shing mar khu ni ci bde bar 'jog pa las gnas nges pa med/ sgrub pa'i mchod yon dang bsangs chu yang g.yon gyi phyogs su 'jog pa lag lan yin/ sum+bha bzlas shing bsangs chu gtor la/ gnas yo byin rlabs bzhin mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya sreg rdzas rnams la bstan te/ 'bru gsum gang mang bzlas/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i las thams cad pa'i thab khung dmar po/ chos 'byung gi dbyibs can/ kha khyer dang mu ran dang*/ stegs bu dang so so'i mtshan ma sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ aḥhūṃ lan bdun bzlas te dpal 'bar spar/ sum+bhas bsangs chu gtor la/ thab la g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor nas me tshang du bcug / oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ/ de nas hūṃ

bdun bzlas te rlung g.yab kyis sbar/ yang sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i me nyid/ raṃ las me lha dkar po bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin zhing*/ pad zla dang ra skyes la gnas pa/ pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i bzhin can/ me lce stong gi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i thugs kar me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum la gnas pa'i raṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ e h+yai hi/ mahā bhū ta/ de wa ṛ ṣi/ dwī dzā/ satwa ma/ gri h-i s+t+wa/ yud+dhaṃ/ a smin pa ni/ hi twa bha ba/ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes pa'i mthe bong nang du bstan pa'i thal mo rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ sum+bha sa bsangs chu gtor te/ phyi 'brang rnams bskrad/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ bsgrubs pa'i mchod yon te/ mchod yon 'bul ba'i snod du blug / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ ag+ni de ba ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag go / oṃ ag+ni ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyi dgang blugs phul la/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya a bī sha bī sha mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍāk+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jig byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ / ces bstod cing spro na/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten sogs kyang bya/ yang gong bzhin dgang blugs gcig phul te/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha kho na mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /yang sum+bha sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i thugs kar hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rwa ba dra ba/ zhes pa nas/ yo ga shud+dho3 'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin gsal btab/ mchod pa la phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par na sgrub mchod kyi mchod 'phreng bzhin nam/ bsdu na tshigs bcad rnams bor ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas phul/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ de nas sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan re dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyi mthar/ bdag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ btags pas dgang blugs phul/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swāhā/ yaṃ shing dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zas mchog / oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ mahā be ga ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ta ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mahā ba la ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa 'bul/ oṃ mahā shrī pha la dha na swāhā/ 'bras bu sna tshogs dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā/ ku sha dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye he ru ka mahā badz+ra ag+na ye swāhā/ bcu pa zhes ba glang gi sha la bdud rtsi bran pa 'bul/ de ltar sreg rdzas tshan pa re re la/ rdzas sngags kyi 'gor lha sngags/ oṃ gsum ma dang me lha'i sngags/ 'jug tu bdag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i/ phyogs thams cad shan+ti~Xṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa re sbyar te tshar gcig phul la/ slar grangs 'dzin pa ni/ spro na rgyas pa la oṃ gsum ma dang*/ 'bring du na sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags/ shin tu bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ste cung zad rgyas pa na/ lha sngags de la gong bzhin las sngags btags pa kho nas bsreg par bya ste/

sdig pa zhi ba la rdzas kyang til nyid la gtso bor bya zhing*/ ma 'byor na yungs kar ro/ /lha sngags gtso bor bzla ba 'di lta bu la/ spyir ni sreg rdzas gang gis kyang kha skong gi grangs 'dzin du rung ngo*/ /thun gyi mthar/ gtor ma dang po rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul zhing*/ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor de/ de dag gtor chog gi skabs bzhin bya la/ gsum pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha la 'bul ni/ oṃ ag+na ye a di bya sogs kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha*/ /'dod pa thams cad rab ster ba/ /rang gzhan don sbyor sa la bzhugs/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos te/ byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni sogs kyi 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs dang*/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ 'dod don zhu ba yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams dkyil 'khor cho ga'i skabs dang 'dra/ me lha spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis mdzad lags kyis/ /mgu zhing tshim par gyur nas kyang*/ /rang gnas bde bar gshegs su gsol/ /gats+tsha gats+tsha swās+tha naṃ/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o/ /thun mang po dang nyin zhag mang po sbrel nas byed na/ thun re bzhin nam ma 'grub na nyin re bzhin/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod rdzas/ sreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa man chad gong bzhin bya'o/ /bsangs chu dang*/ mchod yon sgrubs pa yang kha gso bar spro na bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i mthar de dag la dmigs nas sum+bha ni dang 'bru gsum ci rigs bzla'o/ /sbyin sreg gi me khas mi 'bud pa dang*/ me ma shi bar mi dkrug pa sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/

/lag pa pus mo'i khong las mi 'da' ba dang*/ rdor dril dang ma bral ba byed pa sogs 'di la mi dgos so/ /'di'i sreg rdzas rdzas sngags so so'i 'bul ba'i skabs de 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha la thun mong du 'bul ba yin la/ grangs 'dzin pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa kho na la'o/ /de lta na 'di sbyin sreg 'bring po yin la/ bsdus pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i cho ga rnams dor zhing*/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i skabs kyi rdzas sngags so so ba yang spangs te/ 'bar ba'i phung po nyid drang srong me lha'i ngo bor lhag par mos pas ched pa'o/ /rgyas pa ni/ bde mchog lū nag gi cho ga 'don pa spos pa kho na'o/ /de ltar na rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rim pa rnams ma 'dres par bya'o/ /zhes pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sreg blugs kyi lag len bzhugs/ - PAGE 40 -- PAGE 43 -- PAGE 39 -
